giver: Each `q` is copied character for character from the module or charter named in `cite`, at the line named (counted against the file, not estimated). `origCite` says where the EXPRESSION (transliteration + gloss) is named; "handle" means the term is the historical figure's own and is not in either repo. `script` is the non-Latin spelling, added here: no module carries it.
history: Lived as ARCHON_QUOTES in the-fold/index.html (2026-09-15), feeding a rotating chat-hero motto. That empty-state hero was deleted 2026-09-23 and the table was dead code; on 2026-09-28 the data moved here, so archon material lives in live_priors (content) and eoreader7 (organs), not in the surface.
cite_note: `cite` names the file and line the quote was located at on 2026-09-28, after the archon organs moved to eoreader7 (`eoreader7 native/organs/…`) — several of the original line numbers had already drifted. Where the module's wording no longer contains the quote verbatim, `cite` says so instead of guessing a line. `the-fold …` cites name files still in the-fold (heimdall-client.js).
known_limitation: `canon` (the archon's own canonical line) was never populated; entries with `need` name the source that would supply it. These are the module authors' English lines with the original-language expression beside them, not the archons' own words. Two Nāgārjuna entries (`located: false`) are not found verbatim in nagarjuna.js as it stands today; they are kept as the table had them and should be re-sourced or dropped before any use.
